name: agent_id
description: Optional sub-agent identifier when a registration is scoped per agent.

name: apphub_application_id
description: Primary telemetry identity matched against apphub.application.id.

name: service_name
description: Fallback telemetry service.name paired with environment when apphub.application.id is absent.

name: environment
description: Deployment environment matched against deployment.environment.name or deployment.environment.

name: allowed_landing_places
description: JSON array of authorized Bronze landing-place identifiers for ADR-040 identity binding.

name: business_unit
description: Owning business unit used by silver_restricted caller filtering.

name: sampling_mode
description: Declared sampling mode (full or sampled) per ADR-043.

name: runtime_lane
description: Expected runtime execution lane (agent_runtime, managed_agents_api, agent_vms, aws_agentcore, on_prem).

name: mrm_model_id
description: Optional Model Risk Management inventory identifier.

name: validation_expiry_date
description: Optional MRM model validation expiry date.

name: effective_from
description: SCD-2 inclusive UTC start timestamp for this registration version.

name: effective_to
description: SCD-2 exclusive UTC end timestamp (NULL while active).
